selectionRule: Read-only, factory store (FACTORY_DATABASE_URL_RO), default_transaction_read_only=on, statement_timeout bounded. Per county, one pass over parcel_record_cell restricted to place_key range [fips:, fips;) and rail_key in (zoningJurisdictionKey, zoningDistrict, setbackFrontFt, landUseCode, yearBuilt, situsAddress), grouped by place_key with FILTER aggregates. Bucketed by zoningJurisdictionKey value, or '(no city: <zoningDistrict kind>)' when absent. Within each bucket, within each category, the fixture is the place_key with the lowest md5(place_key) satisfying the category predicate (array_agg(place_key order by md5(place_key)) filter (where <predicate>))[1]. Full query: _inbox/2026-09-16_scaleup-le_fixture_queries.sql.

categoryPredicates.fx_codified: setbackFrontFt cell kind = 'value' (a codified district with a setback value on record)
categoryPredicates.fx_district_miss: setbackFrontFt cell kind = 'absent-verified' and its basis.method starts with 'setback-table-router' (the district has no row in the city's table)
categoryPredicates.fx_no_table: setbackFrontFt cell kind = 'absent-verified' and NOT the district-miss method (the city has no table in the corpus at all)
categoryPredicates.fx_pud: zoningDistrict value matches /(^|[^A-Za-z])(PUD|PDD|PD|PC)([^A-Za-z]|$)/i -- a planned-development-shaped code
categoryPredicates.fx_vacant: landUseCode value ILIKE '%vacant%' OR yearBuilt cell kind != 'value' (no built-year on record), restricted to parcels that also have a codified setback so the fixture is otherwise gradeable

categoriesNotDeterminable.corner_lot: No adjacency/frontage-count signal exists in parcel_record_cell's rail set; selecting a true corner lot needs parcel geometry, which is outside this lane's read scope (atoms/geometry store not used, per operational scope). Not selected by SQL; where a deep-probed fixture happens to be a corner lot that is noted from the live setbacks payload's corner value, not pre-selected.
categoriesNotDeterminable.curved_frontage: Same reason as corner_lot: no frontage-geometry field in parcel_record_cell. Not selected.
